analysis: Reviewed the two head_text units of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 1980-2874). The visible content is documentation only (status, doctor, models, benchmark, update, beta, fan, login/logout/enroll/unenroll, report, logs refusal lines). No code, auth, crypto, or deployment behavior changes in these units. The file_changes ranges show the only edits in this file are at head lines 182, 191, 1360-1385, 1404, 1427, 1475-1485 and 1635-1724. Those ranges are outside the supplied units (1980+) and the patch excerpt is truncated, so edits beyond the excerpt are not examined. Notably the sandbox row (head 182) now says setup requires a Darkbloom Sandbox waitlist approval; I could not see the waitlist anchor or whether it changes TB-013/T-061 (installer download and execution as the owner). Statements in the supplied range are consistent with the threat model: report upload is explicit, privacy-redacted, and device-wide DeviceCheck evidence is labeled not attributable; logout and remote revocation are not conflated (T-053, A-008); status Traffic reporting distinguishes App Attest lease from legacy verification without claiming authorization (T-052, T-057); log refusal lines contain no request text (A-001); the GLM wired-limit advice suggests sudo commands but does not run them (TB-014/T-062 unaffected); prefix-cache status is reporting only and does not change T-041. Remaining question for integration: the changed ranges outside these units (1360-1385, 1635-1724) were not visible here and should be checked if they touch sandbox setup, waitlist gating, or cluster gpu-limit trust claims.
